record.question: To carry all before one
record.explanation: Answer A: be completely successful. “Carry all before one” means be completely successful or victorious. Independent check: “Carry all before one” means achieve complete success. Reference: https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/carry-all-before-one; https://www.dictionary.com/browse/carry. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
